title: Ankara Concept 6A.1 synthetic Signal Collector import dry-run

collector.name: Signal Collector
hardware_requirements: operator SIM/eSIM permitted for the campaign
collector.automation: manual start/stop export; no unattended upload or cloud dependency
collector.licensing: collector export is retained under the campaign operator's permitted use; this fixture is synthetic

device.antenna_basis: built-in handset antenna; vendor response is not relabeled as calibrated gain

coordinate.poor_position_action: retain raw accuracy and row, omit unusable coordinates from canonical geometry

operator.network_context: receive-side modem observation only; no transmitter-side access
operator.consent_note: synthetic fixture; live collection requires operator, site, and participant permissions

measurement.censoring_limitation: empty or unavailable source fields remain missing; no detection floor is invented and no missing row is called censored

detection.unavailable_representation: empty source field retained as missing
detection.invalid_representation: invalid source field retained as an import issue and excluded from the quantity row
detection.censoring_representation: not available in selected V6 export; do not substitute a floor

point_annotations.label: POINT-NR
point_annotations.notes: 28 GHz raw field intentionally omits NR bandwidth

point_annotations.label: POINT-POOR
point_annotations.notes: row retained with poor GNSS accuracy and no fabricated measurement

point_annotations.label: POINT-MISSING
point_annotations.notes: row retained without a location fix and without a fabricated measurement

known_limitations: This file is synthetic controlled data and is not field measurement evidence.
Signal Collector V6 does not guarantee NR bandwidth or resource metadata; the adapter never copies planning bandwidth into an observation.
The selected handset export does not establish calibrated absolute received power or a complete neighbor interference context.
No detection floor or censoring semantics are available in this fixture.

privacy.raw_access: restricted campaign custodians; export and checksum retained separately from canonical observations
privacy.sharing_policy: share only pseudonymous, consented, minimum necessary artifacts; do not publish raw identifiers
